title: Reflexive verbs (present)
summary: Reflexive verbs use an object pronoun that matches the subject: me, te, se, nous, vous, se. Common morning verbs: se lever, se laver.
full_explanation: Reflexive verbs use an object pronoun that matches the subject: me, te, se, nous, vous, se. Common morning verbs: se lever, se laver.

examples.french: Je me lève à sept heures.
examples.english: I get up at seven o'clock.
